simple.prompt: Never in my life ___ such an extraordinary performance.
simple.explanation: Ketika adverb negatif 'Never' diletakkan di awal kalimat untuk penekanan emosional, terjadi inversi: auxiliary + subjek + verb ('have I witnessed').
hints: Auxiliary mendahului subjek: have + I + witnessed.

simple.prompt: Rarely ___ such dedication from an apprentice.

simple.targetSentence: Seldom have I experienced such remarkable hospitality.
simple.explanation: Seldom + have + I + experienced + such remarkable hospitality.

simple.prompt: Little ___ that his life was about to change forever.
simple.explanation: 'Little did he realize' adalah idiom inversi klasik yang menunjukkan ketidaktahuan sama sekali.
hints: Little + auxiliary did + subjek he + realize.

simple.targetSentence: Hardly had they arrived when the thunderstorm began.
simple.explanation: Hardly had they arrived + when the thunderstorm began.
hints: Mulai dengan inversi: 'Hardly had they arrived'.

simple.prompt: Barely ___ out of the building when the fire alarm sounded.
simple.explanation: Barely had + subjek + V3 ('Barely had he stepped...').
hints: Barely berpasangan dengan had + subjek + V3.

simple.targetSentence: Scarcely had I closed my eyes when the telephone rang.
simple.explanation: Scarcely had I closed my eyes + when the telephone rang.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Scarcely had I closed my eyes'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog dramatis dengan inversi 'No sooner... than'.
dialogue: What occurred right after the announcement?
No sooner ___ the speech than the crowd erupted into cheers.
intermediate.explanation: No sooner + had + subjek + V3 ... THAN klausa lampau: 'had the premier finished'.
hints: Pola: No sooner had + subjek + V3.

intermediate.prompt: Inversion with 'Not only... but also': 'Not only ___ the deadline, but she also exceeded sales targets.'
intermediate.explanation: Not only di awal klausa memicu inversi pada klausa pertama: auxiliary 'did' + she + meet.

intermediate.prompt: Inversion with 'Under no circumstances': 'Under no circumstances ___ the laboratory unattended.'
intermediate.explanation: Frasa preposisi restriktif/negatif 'Under no circumstances' mewajibkan inversi: modal (should) + subjek (you) + verb (leave).
hints: Larangan mutlak di awal kalimat memicu inversi.

intermediate.targetSentence: Not until the following morning did we discover the truth.
intermediate.explanation: Not until the following morning (adverbial time) + did we discover (inversion) + the truth.
hints: Mulai dengan 'Not until the following morning'.

intermediate.prompt: Only after: 'Only after the audit was concluded ___ the extent of the loss.'
intermediate.explanation: Pada konstruksi 'Only after / Only when / Only if', klausa utama berikutnya mengalami inversi: did they comprehend.
hints: Inversi terjadi pada klausa utama setelah 'Only after...'.

intermediate.targetSentence: On no account must confidential patient files be shared.
intermediate.explanation: On no account + must (modal) + confidential patient files (subject) + be shared (verb).
hints: Subjek dan pasif: 'confidential patient files be shared'.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog konfirmasi protokol keamanan perbankan.
dialogue: Can bank employees disclose encryption keys to third parties?
In no way ___ employees authorize external key sharing.
intermediate.explanation: 'In no way' bernilai negatif dan memicu inversi modal: 'In no way may employees authorize...'.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki letak inversi pada kalimat bersyarat 'Not until'.
complex.draft: Not until did she speak with her manager she submitted the resignation letter.
options: Not until she spoke with her manager did she submit the resignation letter.
Not until she did speak with her manager she submitted the resignation letter.
Not until did she spoke with her manager she did submit the letter.
complex.explanation: Pada 'Not until [time clause]', inversi BUKAN di dalam anak kalimat 'not until', melainkan di dalam KLAUSA UTAMA: 'Not until she spoke with her manager DID SHE SUBMIT...'.

complex.prompt: Locative inversion (Inversion of place): 'At the top of the steep hill ___ an ancient granite tower.'
complex.explanation: Dalam inversi tempat/lokatif sastra (Locative Inversion), kata kerja utama langsung bertukar posisi dengan subjek tanpa auxiliary 'did': 'stood an ancient granite tower'.
hints: Inversi tempat sastra tidak menggunakan auxiliary 'did'.

complex.prompt: Why is inversion predominantly employed in academic, oratorical, and literary contexts?
options: To introduce rhetorical drama, solemnity, and strong stylistic emphasis to critical arguments.
Because standard SVO order is grammatically forbidden in formal essays.
To prevent readers from reading too quickly.
complex.explanation: Inversi memberikan nuansa retoris yang berbobot, elegan, khidmat, dan memberikan tekanan emosional/logis yang kuat pada gagasan utama.
hints: Tujuan retoris dan penekanan gaya formal.
Pilih opsi rhetorical drama and stylistic emphasis.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat inversi sastra dengan preposisi arah 'Into the room'.
complex.targetSentence: Into the packed boardroom stepped the enigmatic chief executive.
complex.explanation: Into the packed boardroom + stepped (main verb) + the enigmatic chief executive (subject).
hints: Verb langsung mendahului subjek: 'stepped the enigmatic chief executive'.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kekeliruan pasangan konjungsi pada 'No sooner'.
complex.draft: No sooner had the keynote speaker commenced when the microphone malfunctioned.
options: No sooner had the keynote speaker commenced than the microphone malfunctioned.
No sooner had the keynote speaker commenced that the microphone malfunctioned.
No sooner did the keynote speaker commence when the microphone malfunctioned.
complex.explanation: 'No sooner' selalu berpasangan dengan 'THAN' (bukan 'when'). Pasangan 'when' hanya untuk 'Hardly/Scarcely/Barely'.

complex.prompt: Select the sentence with accurate negative inversion syntax:
options: At no time during the trial did the defendant express genuine remorse.
At no time during the trial the defendant expressed remorse.
At no time during the trial did express the defendant remorse.
complex.explanation: Pola baku: At no time + auxiliary (did) + subjek (the defendant) + main verb dasar (express).

dialogue: Does the Prime Minister acknowledge the administrative failure?
Never before in our parliamentary history ___ a cabinet demonstrated such sheer incompetence.
complex.explanation: Never before + auxiliary has + a cabinet (subject) + demonstrated (V3).
